title: [28/1/2023] The nitrogen oxide emissions produced
prompt: The given graph shows the nitrogen oxide emissions produced by four vehicles (no specific time period). Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The line graph illustrates the nitrogen oxide emissions, measured in grams per kilometer, produced by four different types of vehicles at various speeds ranging from 10 to 130 kilometers per hour.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, while diesel and petrol cars showed a U-shaped pattern in their emission levels, with initial decreases followed by increases at higher speeds, lorries and buses maintained relatively stable emissions throughout the speed range. Additionally, diesel cars consistently produced the highest levels of nitrogen oxide, while buses generated the lowest amounts.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at the cars with a U-shaped pattern, diesel vehicles started at approximately 40 g/km at 10 kph, notably higher than petrol cars which began at around 32 g/km. The release from diesel cars then declined to their lowest point of about 25 g/km at 60 kph, before rising steadily to reach roughly 42 g/km at maximum speed. Similarly, petrol cars followed this pattern but at lower levels, dropping to approximately 15 g/km at 90 kph before climbing to about 22 g/km at 130 kph.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Regarding the other vehicles, lorries maintained relatively stable emissions of around 12 g/km throughout most speeds, showing only a slight increase to about 13 g/km at the highest speeds. Meanwhile, buses consistently produced the lowest nitrogen oxide production, starting at roughly 7 g/km and showing a marginal decrease to approximately 5 g/km, maintaining this level for most of the speed range.
